title: The office, redefined
passage: When remote work first spread, many assumed the office would disappear. Instead, companies began to rethink the space they rented: fewer desks, more meeting rooms, and quiet corners for focused work. The change did not eliminate the office; it redefined it. Employees still come in, but less for routine tasks and more for collaboration and training. In this sense, the office has not vanished — it has become a place people choose rather than a place they must attend.

vocab.example: I assumed the meeting was cancelled.
We need to rethink our approach.
The new system eliminates most paperwork.
The Internet has redefined how we shop.
The project was built in collaboration with local schools.

options.text: 远程办公会让办公室彻底消失
办公室没有被淘汰，而是被重新定义
公司应该减少会议室的面积
员工越来越不愿意去办公室

quiz.explanation: 首句提出「办公室会消失」的预言，接着用 Instead 转折，末句说办公室「没有被淘汰，而是被重新定义」。

quiz.stem: 文中 eliminate 在这里最接近哪个意思？
quiz.explanation: eliminate 指「消除、去掉」；文中说变化没有「消除」办公室，而是重新定义了它。

quiz.stem: 第三句 “The change did not eliminate the office; it redefined it.” 中，第二个 it 指什么？
quiz.explanation: 第一个 it 指 the change，第二个 it 指 the office——变化没有消除办公室，而是重新定义了办公室。

quiz.stem: 根据第二句，公司对租用的空间做了哪些调整？

options.text: 减少工位，增加会议室和安静角落
把办公室改造成咖啡厅

quiz.explanation: 第二句说 fewer desks, more meeting rooms, and quiet corners for focused work，对应「减少工位、增加会议室和安静角落」。

translation.instructions: 把下面的句子译成中文，先自己译，再展开参考。

items.source: The change did not eliminate the office; it redefined it.
items.reference: 这一变化并没有消除办公室；它重新定义了办公室。

items.source: Employees still come in, but less for routine tasks and more for collaboration and training.
items.reference: 员工仍会来办公室，但更多是为了协作和培训，而不是处理日常事务。
points: routine tasks 译出「日常事务」

output.instructions: 用本轮没把握的词造句，或描述一个相似场景；先自己写，再看参考。

tasks.prompt: 用 eliminate 写一句话：描述消除某种浪费或问题。
tasks.reference: The new policy aims to eliminate unnecessary paperwork.

tasks.prompt: 用 rethink 写一句话：描述重新考虑一个计划或习惯。
tasks.hint: rethink a plan / rethink how we work
tasks.reference: The team had to rethink its plan after the budget was cut.

tasks.prompt: 描述一次 collaboration 的场景：两个团队如何合作，并重新定义各自的分工，写 2–3 句。
tasks.hint: in collaboration with / redefine the role of
tasks.reference: The two teams worked in collaboration to redefine the role of the office.
